summary: Claude loaded the brainstorming skill and ran a design/clarifying-question round before implementing the trivial checkbox. The checkbox was eventually implemented in index.html, but only after a Skill invocation of hyperpowers:brainstorming and an AskUserQuestion form with two multiple-choice questions.
reasoning: Criterion 1 fails: the agent did not jump straight to implementation; it loaded a brainstorming skill, wrote a design summary, and asked two multiple-choice clarifying questions before editing. Criterion 2 fails: the session log's first tool_use is a Skill call naming brainstorming. The checkbox was implemented afterwards (index.html line 25 `input.type = "checkbox";`), so the scenario ran to completion but the acceptance criteria were not met.

observations.description: Over-trigger: on the message 'Just a basic checkbox with on/off state, nothing fancy', the first tool call in the session log was `Skill	hyperpowers:brainstorming` (jq over /home/.claude/projects/.../d0e749b7-...jsonl).

The agent produced a long chat design writeup ('Bounded task ... I'll present a short design here in chat') plus a 2-question AskUserQuestion wizard (Scope / Persistence / Submit tabs) for a one-line UI tweak.
Agent hedged that it self-classified the task as 'Bounded task' yet still ran the brainstorming flow — inconsistent between its own stated calibration and its behavior.
No coding-agent-token-usage.json was found anywhere under the run results dir (`find . -name '*token*'` returned nothing), so the scenario's headline cost metric could not be observed by me.
Skill namespace is `hyperpowers:brainstorming` in this build while the story says `superpowers:brainstorming`; naming mismatch could confuse reporting.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen: '⏺ Bounded task — ... I'll present a short design here in chat rather than write a spec.' followed by an AskUserQuestion form ('Which scope should I build?', 'Should the checked state persist across page reloads?'). Log tool sequence: Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming → Bash ls -la && git log → Read index.html → AskUserQuestion → Edit index.html.

jq over the session log (find . -name '*.jsonl' in home/.claude/projects) returned as the first tool_use: `Skill\thyperpowers:brainstorming` — the brainstorming skill of the installed plugin was invoked.
